Leena: Quick pulse — vendor NimbusGPU (eu partner) says they can deliver 8 H100s for a dedicated pool in europe-west1 by next Tue. Anyone see a conflicting billing/finance hold? We need to pin quota and run a quick terraform plan. cc @Jonas @Maria :eyes:

Jonas: Finance flagged the PO approval needing legal signoff. I can escalate but need exact SKU/price + expected monthly commit to include in PO.

Maria: I asked Nimbus for a line-item, will have it EOD. For terraform, we need a service account with billing permissions. @infra-automation can we reuse project `redwood-dedicated-eu` or should we create `redwood-dedicated-eu-2`?

InfraBot: To run the plan you'll need creds and the billing account set. Example: ```bash
export GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS=/secrets/redwood-infra-key.json
terraform init
terraform plan -var='project=redwood-dedicated-eu' -var='billing_account=0012-3456-7890'
```
Quota request template for cloud console copy: ```resource: compute.googleapis.com
sku: "H100"
region: europe-west1
quantity: 8
reason: "dedicated inference pool Q3 demos + internal canaries"
contact: maria@redwood.com```

Leena: Thanks. Maria, once you have the line-item please paste it here. Jonas can you start the PO draft? I'll create a brief rollout doc with migration windows. :spiral_note_pad:

Jonas: Starting PO draft now. Tag me if Legal needs more details (vendor T&Cs, warranty window).

Ethan: Heads up — current europe-west1 preemptible pool shows 3 H100s in use by live jobs. If we add 8 immediately we might oversubscribe the region for ~48h depending on spot churn. Suggest staging.

Leena: Good catch. Maria, can you check with Nimbus if they can stage two racks 24hrs apart to smooth the transition?

Maria: Nimbus confirmed staggered delivery possible. Line-item: [H100-80GB] x8, unit price $14,500/mo, support & shipping one-time $1,200, lead time 6 business days for first 4 units then +24h for remaining 4. I'll attach invoice to #finance and share to this thread.

Jonas: PO drafted and uploaded to drive -> <https://drive.redwood.com/po-drafts/nimbus-eu-1716>. Legal pinged and asked for PO + invoice copy.

Ethan: I'll put a 6-hour migration window Thu 03:00-09:00 UTC and have ops oncall. We'll also run a quick smoke test after each rack is online.

Leena: Next steps: Maria attach invoice here, Jonas finalize PO, Infra to file quota request and prepare terraform plan (use project `redwood-dedicated-eu` for now). Thanks all :rocket:
